snippet.title: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 launches for Nintendo Switch on Oct 2, 2025. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-mario-galaxy-plus-super-mario-galaxy-2-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Travel the cosmos with Mario in these two classic games — now with enhanced resolution, improved UI, Assist Mode, and new Storybook content.

Use button, stick and motion controls, play in Assist Mode for additional Health and fall recovery. Plus, learn more about the Lumas in new Storybook chapters.

Two new Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2 amiibo will also be releasing on April 2, 2026.

#SuperMarioGalaxy #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect
